title: One Headphone Ear Switched Into German, Yet Listeners Heard Normal English
description:
You think your ears easily follow two voices at once! Yet repeating one voice makes your other ear miss German! This is the true story of Colin Cherry in London. Here is what went wrong with old phone theory.
